connector.name: MCP Server Tfl
connector.registryDescription: Community-built server providing real-time London transport data via the TfL Unified API
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-server-tfl:1.4.0. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oneill9 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TFL_APP_KEY
env.description: TfL API key — recommended for effective use. Without a key, TfL applies strict rate limits that will impact most real-world usage. Register free at https://api-portal.tfl.gov.uk/
